findings: The production attestation service could not fetch Intel PCK revocation collateral; CDS refused startup.
Read-only inspection confirmed that the guest subnet has no general outbound NAT. Normal Cloud API instances receive explicit egress mappings; these SDK fixtures had none.
The fixed test-control endpoint rejected initial signed requests with HTTP 401; its authentication failure still needs direct diagnosis.

An early failed VM tunnel left its local client waiting. That exact failed initial client was terminated once to trigger the existing startup retry; no CDS operation was submitted through that failed connection.
follow_up: Qualify an owned vendor-only TLS collateral proxy without modifying production NAT, add control-authentication diagnostics and bounded startup attempts, and verify the first guest before preparing all six disks.
